_about: Variant of the ALLOWED case. A baselined site names a consumer that IS declared but is not built in this configuration (optional). That is the case the zombie rule must NOT flag: not built is not the same as deleted. Expected: PASS.

synth_config._note: Qt6::Qml is allowed -- Qml is not Quick, and core runs profile scripts through QJSEngine. Qt6::Network is listed only because Qt6::Qml re-exports it.

synth_platform._note: Qt6::Gui PUBLIC is allowed for a platform adapter: a public header puts QKeySequence in its signature. Gui is not Widgets.

synth_absent_app._note: Stands in for a UI test that a headless configuration does not build. Declared, therefore alive.

exceptions.reason: Stands in for the real baseline in which the component-private implementation links the OS adapter: an edge that exists, is named, owned, and therefore does not fail the check.
The site's target is declared and merely unbuilt here, so it is neither stale nor a zombie.
